:root{--yellow:#ffdc00;--ink:#29291f;--paper:#fffdf3;--muted:#777568}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
header{background:var(--yellow);padding:28px 18px 24px;text-align:center;border-bottom:5px solid var(--ink)}

.sub{margin:0;font-size:15px}
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--ink);padding:10px 12px;display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap}
nav a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #77745e;border-radius:20px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px}
main{max-width:760px;margin:22px auto;padding:0 15px 50px}
.intro{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;margin:0 0 20px}
.category{background:#fff;border:1px solid #eee6c6;border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin:0 0 16px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #29291f0b;scroll-margin-top:68px}
h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:23px;margin:0 0 12px;padding-bottom:9px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--yellow)}
.item{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #e6e1d1;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35}
.item:last-child{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:2px}
.item strong{white-space:nowrap;color:#5b5200;font-size:14px}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;text-align:center;padding:22px 15px;font-size:13px}
footer strong{color:var(--yellow);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:20px}
@media(min-width:650px){main{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start}.category{margin:0}}
</style>
